note: Re-judged 2026-11-02 by an independent auditor who authored none of the changes named. RFC 9687 Section 4.3: "Each time the local system sends a BGP message, it restarts the SendHoldTimer unless the SendHoldTime value is zero or the negotiated HoldTime value is zero, in which case the SendHoldTimer is stopped." ff89fc8110 (a withdraw verdict withdraws both families) changed only the egressRouteFilter closure in the tagged unit to the new three-value signature (suppress, override, follow); session_write.go writeUpdateGated and the raw-forward path read the first two exactly as before and the policy cases answer suppress with a nil override and nil follow, so every input and every assertion is unchanged. TestRFC9687SuppressedAttemptsDoNotRestartSendHold still requires a suppressed, held, batched or duplicate attempt to leave the exact SendHold deadline unmoved, which fails if a write that emitted nothing restarted the timer; the positives (emission, every writer, remaining writers) are byte-identical. Zero-time exception stays with RFC9687-4.3-9. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
